description.en-US: Matterleast is an unofficial Android app for Mattermost servers that tries to feel closer to Discord than to a classic team chat. All your servers and teams sit in one rail, and chats slide in over the channel list and away again with a swipe. Features - Discord-style navigation: a rail with every server and team, swipe a chat away to the channel list and swipe it back - One Home inbox across all servers for unread messages, mentions, threads and saved messages - Notifications without Google's push service: the app checks in the background, or stays connected if you turn that on - Two or three panes side by side on tablets and in landscape - Matterleast colours, your Mattermost theme or your wallpaper colours (Material You) To use this app, you need the address of a Mattermost server and an account on it. The app talks to that server and, depending on its settings and the messages you open, to other hosts such as link previews, images and the server's plugins. Since these services aren't necessarily free software, it's labeled with "NonFreeNet". Matterleast is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mattermost, Inc.
